Create your own music video by controlling Hatsune Miku!

The process of clearing the riddles is all recorded, so you will be able to create your own music video.

Controles

Move and click only!

Easy and intuitive controls.

Focus your cursor on suspicious objects and click on it. Once you clear the game, you can play a hidden mode⁉ An escape room game set in the music video "KOEGASURU" by TEMPLIME!

Introduction of Creators

TEMPLIME

TEMPLIME is a music unit consisting of composer KBSNK and DJ tempura. They began their activities in April 2019 and released their debut track “Neon Light,” featuring digital artist Toto Hoshimiya.

In 2020, their album “Cloud Diver” ranked 4th on the Billboard Japan Download Albums Chart. Since then, they have been active in various collaborations, including an official remix for Vaundy, and providing tracks for artists and projects such as Tomori Kusunoki, Denkoubu, Kokonatsu 2.0, and ExWHYZ.

In March 2023, their track “Escapism” was selected for Porter Robinson’s playlist “cherished music”, gaining international attention.

In 2024, they released “EMPT MILE”, their first full-length album as a solo project, continuing to pursue their musical activities with vigor.

MOCHIDAIKOUGAKUBU

A creative circle consisting of Zumochi, in charge of illustration and 3D modeling, and YuKiMuMa, responsible for programming, video production, and product development.
